summary: Architectural plan for the High School Chemistry Reaction Practice application covering Halogen Single Replacement, Metal Single Replacement, Double Replacement Precipitations, Mixed Mode with sequential 3-step mastery (type identification -> product prediction -> equation balancing), and a 6-question Homework module with instant client-side PDF generation. Includes an interactive reference drawer with Activity Series and Solubility Rules, plus smart chemical formula inputs with auto-subscripts.
